category.name: zoo.event.circus
category.item: Welcome to the traveling circus! Introducing the Mystery Box! Buy one box and get one of 10 animals. You can have up to 20 boxes at a time, and each box can be opened after 5 hours. Have fun!
The following animals have been added to your inventory: %animal%. Get even more Mystery Boxes to get even more unique animals!
You already have 20 Mystery Boxes. Wait until one of them opens and then get another one.
The Mystery Box will open in: %amount%
While you were away, your animals from the Mystery Box got thirsty. Keeper Sonja took care of them and brought them to her inventory. Quickly, take a look!
